$comment: Development-only harness config. NOT product configuration.
Each entry becomes one VS Code instance running an Extension Development Host
for THIS repository's extension source, opened on the given Game workspace.
'workspace' is resolved relative to the repository root, so sibling checkouts
extensionDevelopmentPath is NEVER read from this file — host-launch-plan.mjs
always derives it from this repo's own root, so no host entry here can ever
substitute a Game's own files as the extension implementation serving it.
'gametest' is deliberately kept: SidelineCoach-GameTest's workspace contains an
old historical copy of SidelineCoach source, making it an excellent regression
fixture that its Stadium still runs the CURRENT canonical extension regardless.
Point SIDELINE_DEV_VSCODE at a Code.exe / code binary to override discovery.
